decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a specialist market with long procurement cycles where the firm's robustness know-how gives an edge, so there is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search, and slack allows patience.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the firm's ergonomic office portfolio, and one year is too early to judge it below aspiration.
This second-generation core interior luminaire, actively promoted as newly arrived, is central to the established business and very unlikely to be dropped.
The microprismatic pendant fits the firm's push into standards-compliant, glare-controlled office lighting, and there is no sign of underperformance.
The HMI lamp technology runs against the firm's LED direction, so it carries some risk of rationalisation, but the specialist marine niche and slack favour keeping it for now.
The marine searchlight complements the naval and marine portfolio with modest carrying costs, so the firm would likely keep it while results remain uncertain.
